checks.actual: Original authored20-item fixtures, two mock rows and forty failed diagnostics retain their handover identities. New evaluator runs use separate frozen directories and preserve scheduled, refused, cancelled, ambiguous and failed rows through resume/export; no historical week5 result is overwritten. Current upgrade: OpenQA and MCQ each schedule the exact first 64 native validation rows plus first 64 native test rows across E0/E1: 256 conditions per protocol, 512 total. Real v5/DeepSeek settings are frozen, E0 has no retrieval and E1 stays R0 dense top five. All failures/refusals/invalid outcomes stay in the denominator. Freeze files describe the pre-execution moment, not later progress. Terminal protocol observation: Both frozen real DeepSeek protocols completed the exact first 64 validation and first 64 test rows under E0/E1: 256 conditions per protocol, 512 unique durable run/item identities total. OpenQA retained 226 completed, 28 refused and 2 pre-provider memory-error outcomes; MCQ retained 215 completed and 41 refused. Pooled E0 to dense-E1 OpenQA EM changed 0.234375 to 0.140625 and token F1 0.4169663016 to 0.3008987503; MCQ selection accuracy changed 0.96875 to 0.671875. The negative E1 finding uses all scheduled outcomes. Durable call reservations are 260 OpenQA and 257 MCQ, not a billing statement; unknown cost remains null. Independent AI report-consistency reviews passed; human ratings remain null.
